title: Vertex-distinguishing chromatic index of digraphs
summary: Let $D$ be a digraph. In this note, an \emph{arc coloring} of $D$ is an assignment of colors to the arcs of $D$ such that no two arcs with a common tail receive the same color and no two arcs with a common head receive the same color. Under such a coloring, each vertex $v$ is associated with an \emph{out-color set} and an \emph{in-color set}, consisting of the colors assigned to the arcs with tail $v$ and to the arcs with head $v$, respectively.
